$comment: Machine-readable source of truth for the mods Trance reimplements. See TRANCE.md section 8. Verified 2026-08-24 against sineorg/store marketplace.json and zen-browser.github.io/theme-store/themes.json. Phase 3 (surfaces) landed 2026-08-24; Phase 4 (sidebar-tabs) 2026-08-25; Phases 5 (chrome-furniture + icons) and 6 (motion-feedback) 2026-08-25. Two verdicts were changed by their investigations: mod 7 NATIVE->ZEN, mod 14 NATIVE->DEFER. See investigationDoc fields.

verdictLegend.ADAPT: Permissive license (MIT/Apache-2.0). Code may be ported with attribution and license retention.
verdictLegend.ZEN: Stock Zen already provides this; configure rather than build.

mods.name: Advanced Tab Groups
mods.notes: Near-total overlap with stock Zen folders: grouping, subfolders, icon picker and collapsed-with-active-tab are all zen-folder's. Firefox already owns tab-group colour, palette and persistence (TabGroupState). Trance adds a colour submenu on Zen's #zenFolderActions and a section-style header. MIT permits adapting; nothing needed adapting.

mods.name: Better New Tab Button
mods.notes: Unlabelled centred plus, and a press rotation owned by trance.motion.level rather than by a pref of its own. Its per-component radius sliders were dropped: Trance has one radius scale and the anti-conflict design rests on one owner per value.

mods.name: BetterZenGradientPicker
mods.notes: Builds on Zen's own gradient engine (zen.theme.gradient.*).

mods.name: Context Menu Icons
mods.notes: The icon cluster's source. MIT, so both packs are copied verbatim and the ~270-selector mapping is adapted by scripts/trance-icons.py with every !important stripped. Its item-hiding, fold-menu script and bookmark-bar extras were dropped.

mods.name: Customize Collapsed Sidebar
mods.notes: Landed as the collapsed rail in TranceTabStrip. Defaults are the user's own mod.ccs.* values. Zen's rail sizing is !important on :root; Trance redeclares the consuming variables on #navigator-toolbox instead (ADR-015).

mods.name: Deta Loading Bar
mods.notes: Rebuilt on nsIWebProgressListener rather than adapted. The MIT original shows four of the eight failure modes at once: infinite animation, animating width (a layout property) at display rate, a per-frame filter: blur(), and a permanently promoted .browserStack. Fourteen prefs became three.

mods.name: Floating Status Bar
mods.notes: Verdict changed from NATIVE to ZEN by investigation: zen.theme.styled-status-panel already floats the status panel and is on by default on macOS. No Trance code; the Zen pref is surfaced on the Trance settings page.

mods.name: Hide Extension Name
mods.notes: Three lines of CSS. Trance writes the same rule without the !important a userChrome sheet needs. MIT recorded anyway.

mods.name: Live Calendar
mods.notes: Known offender: setInterval clock. Must use TranceScheduler.onWallClock.

mods.name: Nebula
mods.notes: GPL-3.0 — absolutely no code copying. User requires it in full. Ships as the default surface preset.

mods.name: New Icons
mods.notes: Contributes a coverage requirement — the icon set must reach the toolbar, panels and the site-information panel — and no assets. Unlicensed, so nothing was taken; the glyphs come from Context Menu Icons' MIT packs.

mods.name: Nova UI
mods.notes: Phase 3 landed the flat preset's geometry; Phase 5 landed the panel and menu spacing, radius, edges and scrollbars, all from tokens that already existed. Its mute-button visualiser (an infinite animation), custom font and essentials flattening were dropped.

mods.name: Pimp your PiP
mods.notes: No homepage in the store index. Source lives inside zen-browser/theme-store (MIT repo) but per-mod terms unconfirmed.

mods.name: Render.js
mods.notes: Verdict changed from NATIVE to DEFER by investigation, answering TRANCE.md §16 Q8. Each of its five behaviours duplicates an owner Trance has already assigned — Zen's space animation, Phase 7's calendar, Phase 5's new-tab button, the tab strip — and 'ambient motion' cannot be specified, built or accepted.

mods.name: SuperPins
mods.notes: Two of eighteen behaviours survived investigation: sticky pinned tabs (CSS) and lazy pinned tabs (browser.sessionstore.restore_pinned_tabs_on_demand, surfaced not reimplemented). Grid layout dropped per user, confirming grid-count=1 in their profile. Does not patch ZenPinnedTabManager.

mods.name: Tab Closing Bubble Animation
mods.notes: The one Phase 6 behaviour that genuinely cannot be CSS. Clean-room: TabClose rather than a MutationObserver, Web Animations through TranceMotion rather than keyframes plus a timer, one getBoundingClientRect per burst rather than one per bubble.

mods.name: Transparent Zen
mods.notes: Same author as the Zen Internet extension. Chrome transparency only — Zen Internet owns content-area transparency.

mods.name: Unloaded Tabs
mods.notes: Sole owner of the unloaded-tab appearance, absorbing SuperPins' competing strike-through and dimming knobs. Attribute-driven; no observer.

mods.name: Zen Compact Transparent Mode
mods.notes: Becomes the 'compact' surface preset, not a second blur stack.

mods.name: Zen Context Menu
mods.notes: Thirty-two hide-toggles dropped under §8.2; the workspace-colour menu tint kept. Its requirement that macOS native context menus be turned off became an opt-in pref that is off by default, because that trade is real (ADR-020).

mods.name: Zen Custom URL Bar
mods.notes: Eight prefs became two. Only the page-recede effect survived: the colour and radius work belongs to TranceSurfaces' overlay region, and the page-scaling default was already off in the mod itself.

mods.name: Zen Folder Tree Connectors
mods.notes: Clean-room, no source read. Trunk and elbows in CSS alone by styling .zen-tab-group-start, an anchor Zen puts in every folder container and never styles. The original ships a .uc.js.

mods.name: Zen Library
mods.notes: Unlicensed and required in full. Highest-value target for relicensing outreach.
